title: cyclophorus nummulariifolius var. obovatus
intro: Cyclophorus nummulariifolius var. obovatus, commonly known as the Obovate Cyclophorus or a variety of Cyclophorus nummulariifolius, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cyclophoridae. It is a type of medicinal plant that has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian herbal medicine, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions. The health benefits of Cyclophorus nummulariifolius var. obovatus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant properties.
